Original manually authored OOXML from tools/leading_break_spacing_fixture.py. The generator reuses only this repository's own minimal section-spacing OPC scaffold. The native reference PDF exports retain all 78 pages and baseline coordinates. Modes 11, 12, 14 and 15, explicit suppression off in mode 15, and suppression on in mode 14 are covered. Leading single/repeated page breaks defer the before-gap and subtract the preceding after-gap, clamped at zero. Initial paragraphs have no preceding gap. Text or spaces before a break make it a mid-paragraph break without a deferred before-gap. The suppression flag removes that gap. Every source and reference has a SHA-256 hash. No third-party template content.
